Syril Karn, Division Chief, Bureau of Standards.''"
"''I know you.|Syril Karn to guard|}} A [[human]] '''guard''' with light colored skin, [[color|green]] [[eye]]s and red [[hair]] that worked for [[Galactic Empire]] at the [[Imperial office complex]] in [[Palmo]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Ghorman]]. In [[3 BBY]] he was working a night shift with a [[Unidentified Imperial office complex guard 2|fellow guard]] when [[Syril Karn]], the [[Division Chief]] for the [[Bureau of Standards Ghorman field office]], came to the complex after-hours and interrupted the pair watching [[podracing]] on a [[datapad]]. He scanned Karn's badge which flashed red, indicating that he did not have after-hours clearance. However Karn was able to persuade the guards to let him into his office by telling them he needed his notes from his office to prepare for a presentation with the [[Sector Committee]] tomorrow. The guard had light skin, [[green]] [[eye]]s and red [[hair]]. While working the night shift the guard wore an all black [[Imperial officer]] uniform. ==Behind the scenes== The guard was portrayed by [[Robin Berry]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The guard is identified in the episode's credits as simple "IOC guard #1". ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Who Are You?}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=იმპერიული ოფისების კომპლექსის უცნობი მცველი 1 }} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]]
